name: Diego Mitchell
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I still remember the missing brother in our first classroom play.” People around the brick passage off the shop row know Diego by a small Sunday habit. Diego takes the longer way when the smell from the ovens reaches the pavement.
voice: I did the same scene six times and only the oldest listener guessed where the missing brother had gone.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a charcoal zip cardigan and a watch on a cracked leather band. Diego has a small notch in the left eyebrow, with salt-and-pepper curls. Diego holds eye contact until the other person has finished during a conversation.
personality: Diego tells a better story in a kitchen than at a microphone. Family members sometimes underestimate how far Diego will go to back a quiet opinion once it is actually challenged.
agenda: To meet the listener who understood the ending.
family: Patrick Osborne is Diego’s first cousin once removed. Diego makes the call. Patrick is free to hang up first. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The third bedroom*, Patrick says, “I am the lodger who offered to leave. I need six weeks and a guarantor, which nobody remembered to ask about.”
connections: Gerard Marquez. The pretend landlord is the listener who guesses where the missing character went.

reactions.situation: A visitor wants to record a private performance
reactions.response: Diego asks the actor and the sole listener separately before allowing a recording.

reactions.situation: A stranger waves a phone camera in a crying person's face
reactions.response: Diego asks the filmer to lower the phone and gets another familiar face to stand by the person crying.
reactions.asWritten: A stranger waves a phone camera in a crying person's face. Diego asks the filmer to lower the phone and gets another familiar face to stand by the person crying.

reactions.situation: If a relative makes a joke at a child's expense
reactions.response: Diego repeats the child's actual point and waits for a reply to that.
